section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the analytic strategy for a daily diary study using multilevel modeling to examine hierarchical data structures. The text explains the disaggregation of within-persons and between-persons variance, centering procedures, and the specification of four multilevel models examining intuitive eating, body appreciation, body image concerns, and negative affect as criteria variables, with BMI as a covariate and interactions between self-compassion and frequency of interactions with body-focused others.
